thread:
Iris N.: FYI opening incident - increased 5xxs and p99 for hosted text-gen in ap-south. Posting live status: https://status.redwood.inference/incident/1965432100
SRE-Bot: ALERT: text-gen::error_rate > 5% (3m) | p99 latency 12.4s | affected: hosted-textgen-ap-south
Oncall Eng: picking up. Initial check shows surge of long-running completions tied to a customer batch job that started at 03:14 UTC. Appears to cause request queueing on the model pods.
Infra-Team: mitigation plan: 1) scale replica set up 3->9, 2) route new traffic to other regions for non-data-resident tenants, 3) enable short-circuit for very long prompt lengths (>8k tokens). Starting scale now.
Comms: drafting status banner. Suggest severity SEV-2 until we see error rate <1% for 15m.
Oncall Eng: scale triggered: `kubectl -n hosted scale deployment/text-gen-ap-south --replicas=9`. Also updated routing policy to prefer eu-central for non-APAC tenants.
Telemetry: after scale (03:28 UTC) errors dropped to 0.9%, p99 to 2.6s. Still monitoring for tail spikes.
Iris N.: impact note for status page: "Customers in APAC may have experienced elevated latency and 5xx between 03:14-03:27 UTC; mitigation applied and services recovering." Comms, please publish.
Comms: banner posted and targeted emails queued for accounts with >2% error. Link to runbook and incident doc: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/queue-throttling and https://redwood-internal/docs/incidents/1965432100.
Oncall Eng: follow-ups: add protection to reject extremely long-burst batched requests at the ingress and add canary that simulates large prompt bursts next week. Also capture the offending client request pattern for customer outreach.
Iris N.: status -> recovering. Will monitor 30m and then move to resolved if stable. Postmortem owner assigned: infra-team@redwood; ticket placeholder created. Thanks all :heart:
